answer: An attestation is weighted by reciprocity, meaning a vote counts in proportion to the work that voter has already had graded, so a fresh cluster votes at zero. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, which forces a farm to rent distinct networks at distinct prices. Rewards then vest over 100 epochs rather than paying at once. On the payout terrace that reads as a slow stream, and the attacker's ridge of clones ends up a relic: no payout until real work sits behind it.
